channel.title: Twilio incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Twilio's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Multiple Networks in Ireland [investigating]
item.description: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery delays from Twilio to network subscribers on multiple networks in Ireland. Our team is actively investigating this issue. We will provide another update in 2 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

item.title: Messaging Services Message Send Failures [resolved]
item.description: Our engineers have investigated and resolved an issue with Messaging Services. From 10:28AM PDT on Tuesday, 7/21/26 to 6:00PM PDT on Friday, 9/4/26, customers may have experienced HTTP 400 responses with Twilio error code 21620 when sending messages through Messaging Services if the media URL parameter contained a comma. The issue has been resolved and all impacted services are operating normally.

item.title: Twilio Messaging Services Was Degraded [resolved]
item.description: Twilio Messaging Services was degraded for 46 days between July 21 2026 3:28 PM and Sept 4 2026 6:00 PM Pacific Time . During this period of time, customers that sent messages with media url that contained a comma and added the messaging service sid parameter in their messages will have their messages messages incorrectly rejected with http 400 and Twilio error code 21620 .
